<thought>We need to list all possible precursor sets for the given product using template 1914389. The mapped reaction SMILES provided in the template shows the two reactants (precursors) on the left side of the “>>”. By stripping the atom‑mapping annotations (e.g., “:8”) we obtain the SMILES of the two precursors:

1. The aldehyde fragment of the silyl‑protected sugar.  
2. The phosphonate ester used in the HWE coupling.

These two SMILES constitute the only precursor combination for this template.

</thought>
